actions.title: Prepare a numbered board attempt
actions.instruction: From a clean main branch in the native terminal, run the installed Academy Prepare command for your operating system.
actions.rationale: Prepare records the queued board state on a numbered attempt while preserving main.
actions.expected_result: Academy creates and switches to academy/F03-work-the-board/ATTEMPT_NUMBER with academy.feature.0001 queued.
actions.recovery: If Prepare refuses, preserve its message and resolve only the named main-branch, clean-worktree, or prerequisite condition.
actions.evidence: The numbered branch fixes the board snapshot that Check will compare.

actions.title: Read the exact queued task
actions.instruction: Read the academy.feature.0001 line and its adjacent boundaries before changing the board. This lesson changes only that lifecycle.
actions.rationale: Reading the full task prevents a similarly named task or the listed feature work from becoming the evidence change.
actions.expected_result: You can identify academy.feature.0001 as the single queued target and can leave every other task unchanged.
actions.recovery: If the target is absent or not queued, stop and preserve the attempt. Do not substitute another task.
actions.evidence: Your intended change is limited to one existing task line.

actions.title: Start the target through CodeArbiter
actions.instruction: In the active CodeArbiter harness, use the host-native task command to start academy.feature.0001. This is an agent command, never a shell command.
actions.rationale: The sanctioned transition writes the canonical started state instead of a hand-edited checkbox.
actions.expected_result: The task writer changes only academy.feature.0001 to its canonical started state with a real started date.
actions.recovery: If the command blocks, preserve its message and inspect the exact target state. Do not imitate the transition by editing the board.
actions.evidence: The transient started state demonstrates the required lifecycle order.

actions.title: Inspect the transient started state
actions.instruction: Inspect the target immediately after Start. Confirm its marker is [~] and that its started date is present before continuing.
actions.rationale: The final done state is accepted only after the sanctioned start transition has occurred.
actions.expected_result: The target line is [~] with a started date while its description and every other task line remain unchanged.
actions.recovery: If the line is not canonical started form, stop and preserve the attempt rather than applying a manual repair.
actions.evidence: You observed the required intermediate lifecycle state before completion.

actions.title: Complete the same task through CodeArbiter
actions.instruction: Use the host-native CodeArbiter task command to complete the same academy.feature.0001 target. Do not implement the feature named by the task.
actions.rationale: The governed done transition preserves the task wording and adds the canonical completion date.
actions.expected_result: The target becomes [x] with canonical done YYYY-MM-DD text and no other board content changes.
actions.recovery: If completion blocks, preserve the attempt and the started state. Do not force a date or manually mark the task done.
actions.evidence: The final target line contains the task-writer-produced completion state.

actions.title: Inspect the final board diff
actions.instruction: Review the unstaged board diff before staging. It must show only academy.feature.0001 moving through its canonical lifecycle.
actions.rationale: A focused diff catches unrelated task, prose, and fixture edits before they enter the evidence commit.
actions.expected_result: The diff changes only the target line from its prepared queued state to canonical done form.
actions.recovery: If another line changed, stop before staging and preserve the attempt for the appropriate retry path.
actions.evidence: The reviewed diff limits the future commit to the board lifecycle.

actions.title: Stage only the board
actions.instruction: Stage only .codearbiter/open-tasks.md. Do not use a broad add command.
actions.rationale: The lesson requires one board-only governed commit.
actions.recovery: If another path is staged, stop and preserve the state for review. Do not erase the attempt to make status look clean.
actions.evidence: The staged path is the single allowable evidence path.

actions.title: Review the board-only commit boundary
actions.instruction: Ask the active harness to show the staged path list and staged diff without committing. Review the answer before authorizing the gate.
actions.rationale: Learner review keeps the governed commit bounded to the one canonical board transition.

variants.command: Show the staged path list and staged diff. Do not commit. Report whether the staged path list is exactly .codearbiter/open-tasks.md and whether only academy.feature.0001 changes from queued to canonical done form.

Show the staged path list and staged diff. Do not commit. Report whether the staged path list is exactly .codearbiter/open-tasks.md and whether only academy.feature.0001 changes from queued to canonical done form.

Show the staged path list and staged diff. Do not commit. Report whether the staged path list is exactly .codearbiter/open-tasks.md and whether only academy.feature.0001 changes from queued to canonical done form.

actions.expected_result: The agent presents one staged board path and the exact target lifecycle diff for learner approval.
actions.recovery: If the path list or diff is broader, do not approve a commit. Preserve the attempt and recover from the reported boundary.
actions.evidence: The learner approved one bounded board change, not the whole worktree.

actions.title: Run the governed commit gate
actions.instruction: After learner approval, run the host-native CodeArbiter commit gate. Do not replace it with direct git commit.
actions.rationale: The gate records one board-only governed commit on the prepared attempt.
actions.expected_result: CodeArbiter creates one post-Prepare commit containing only .codearbiter/open-tasks.md.
actions.recovery: If the gate blocks, preserve its output and correct only the reported boundary. Do not bypass the gate or amend the attempt.
actions.evidence: The commit is durable evidence for the completed board lifecycle.

actions.title: Confirm the attempt is clean
actions.instruction: Inspect short Git status after the governed commit and before Check. The Academy ignore rule treats .codearbiter/open-tasks.md.lock as the sole task-writer sidecar exception.
actions.rationale: Check evaluates the committed board lifecycle and the current worktree state together.
actions.expected_result: Git prints no non-ignored worktree state. Academy intentionally ignores only .codearbiter/open-tasks.md.lock.
actions.recovery: If status shows non-ignored state, preserve it and do not run Check until you understand its source. Do not delete or reset an attempt branch.
actions.evidence: The worktree and index match the board-only commit apart from the sole ignored task-writer lock.

actions.title: Run the external Academy Check
actions.instruction: Run the installed Academy Check command from the numbered attempt after the board-only commit and clean-state review.
actions.rationale: Check compares the prepared board, completed board, commit boundary, and live worktree from outside the learner checkout.
actions.expected_result: Check reports checkpoint F03-work-the-board: passed and records progress only when the exact board transition and no non-ignored worktree state agree.
actions.recovery: If Check fails, preserve the attempt and read the failed predicate before using Reset for a distinct numbered retry.
actions.evidence: Check cannot prove the agent command ran and cannot prove the learner observed the transient [~] state. It proves only the committed board state, commit boundary, and non-ignored worktree state it can inspect.

actions.title: Preserve a failed attempt and retry
actions.instruction: Use Reset only when Check identifies a failed attempt that must remain available. Run the installed Academy command from the native terminal.
actions.rationale: Reset retains the failed branch and creates a new numbered attempt instead of rewriting evidence.
actions.expected_result: Academy preserves the failed attempt and switches to a fresh academy/F03-work-the-board/ATTEMPT_NUMBER branch.
actions.recovery: If Reset stops, preserve its message and current branch. Do not force-push, force-reset, or delete the failed attempt.
actions.evidence: The original attempt remains available while the retry has a separate base.

actions.title: Return to main after success
actions.instruction: After Check passes, switch to main and leave the completed attempt branch intact.
actions.rationale: Returning to main ends the exercise without discarding the evidence-bearing branch.
actions.expected_result: Git switches to main while the completed F03 attempt remains reachable.
actions.recovery: If Git refuses, preserve its message and current state. Do not force a branch switch or remove the attempt.
actions.evidence: The completed branch remains available for later verification.
